content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to show larger counter values on the [product_name] display, but I'm not sure if this can be achieved or how to do it. My first thought was to combine two counters—such as having the first counter at 250 and the second at 31, resulting in 31000250 as the displayed value. Is it possible to show the first counter value with leading zeros on the display? My second idea is to use individual counters for each digit (units, tens, hundreds, thousands, etc.), but I'm unsure if it's possible to display a single-digit value on the display individually. Does anyone have an alternative method for displaying larger values? Thank you
No, neither of these approaches work with either the [product_name] or its TDE display. The display cannot support those kinds of flexible formatting options.
